summary: Bio-Techne Corp filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement with Merck KGaA and its wholly-owned subsidiary EMD Holdings NewCo, Inc. Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge with and into Bio-Techne, with Bio-Techne surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent. Shareholders will receive $73.00 per share in cash, valuing the equity at an implied enterprise value based on the cash consideration. The board has approved the merger, declared it advisable, and recommends shareholder approval. No premium percentage or break fee was stated. The transaction is subject to shareholder approval and customary closing conditions. Watch for shareholder vote timeline and potential competing bids.
